title: Game UI Freeze when interacting with non-embedded subwindows
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.2, 4.2 Mono, 4.4.1 Mono, 4.5 Mono, 4.5.1 Mono, 4.5.2 Mono, 4.6.2 Mono

### System information

Godot v4.6.2.stable.mono (001aa128b) - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu, 02 Apr 2026 23:33:01 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (RADV GFX1201) - AMD Ryzen 9 9900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads) - 60.43 GiB memory

### Issue description

When I disable the `Embed Subwindows` project setting, opening a sub-window (e.g. opening a menu, a dialog, or hovering a tooltip) the game UI freezes and requires a force stop to kill. This started happening for me around 4 or 5 months ago, but I re-enabled `Embed Subwindows` and forgot about it until starting a new project.

Pretty similar to what was reported previously in #111931 #114986 and #115371 with the main difference being that my freezes only happen in my running project (via editor or an exported build) not the editor, and I'm on an entirely AMD system.

Freezes only occur on Forward+ renderer, when using Compatibility renderer native subwindows work as expected. Possibly a separate issue, but mentioned here just in case, if I set `Editor Settings -> Run -> Platforms -> Prefer Wayland` non-embedded subwindows are never opened when ran in editor and the Output panel reports ` ERROR: More than one Wayland client per PID tried to create a window.`

https://youtu.be/mnD-zUoJrMk

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new project with Forward+ renderer
2. Disable `Project Settings -> Embed Subwindows`
3. Add a button with a tooltip
4. Hover over the button until the tooltip displays

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26867737/mrp.zip)
